The '''Volcanic Frost Lurker''' was a rare type of fish native to the planet of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], specifically the [[Icetromper Lake]]. Occasionally these fish would be driven to the surface by volcanic activities, at which point they became targets for ice fishing. They were known to be appreciated by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="Ice Fishing" />
